## What's Changed

- Add typed, metadata-validated investigation filters across all connectors, with native query translation owned by each integration.
- Add bounded duplicate-group queries for Elasticsearch, ClickHouse, BigQuery, and VictoriaLogs; other connectors clearly report unsupported exhaustive grouping.
- Preserve query intent and explicit All time through clarifications, and display native query language and executed query.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/InvestiGenie/investigenie/compare/0.6.4-rc...0.6.5-rc
